answered.q: Are the requested dates a federal holiday?
answered.a: Feb 15, 2027 is Washington's Birthday (Presidents' Day), a federal holiday. Source S14.

answered.q: Which Las Vegas restaurants currently hold Michelin stars?
answered.a: Four in the 2026 guide: Joël Robuchon (Two Stars); L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon, Restaurant Guy Savoy, é by José Andrés (One Star each). Source S1.

answered.q: Is there a subway in Las Vegas?
answered.a: Not found in the official RTC material reviewed. RTC describes bus service (S15). Treat the 1-hour test as bus-only until a source says otherwise.

answered.q: Can I get to Red Rock by bus?
answered.a: No. BLM states public transportation does not extend to Red Rock Canyon (S16).

answered.q: When do starred restaurants open reservations?
answered.a: Most release tables 30 to 60 days ahead (S1). é by José Andrés allows online booking up to three months ahead (S4).

suggestions.title: Track live rates on a fixed schedule
suggestions.detail: Record official rates for Feb 15–18 and Feb 15–22, 2027 for each hotel every week and keep a history table. This answers the 'cheapest time to book' question.
suggestions.needs: Your OK to make a weekly check.

suggestions.title: Run the 1-hour bus test with RTC Trip Planner
suggestions.detail: For each hotel and each Michelin venue, record bus travel time on a weekday evening. Adds a verified travel column.
suggestions.needs: Your OK; choose weekday/time to test.

suggestions.title: Add a 'Last verified' date to every row
suggestions.detail: Each row shows the date its source was checked, so stale values are easy to spot.

suggestions.title: Add a link checker and table-completeness check to publishing
suggestions.detail: Build fails if a row has no source link or a broken internal link. The scripts/verify_site.py script already does this locally; GitHub Actions could run it on each push.
suggestions.needs: Approve adding a GitHub Actions workflow.

suggestions.title: Split restaurants by neighborhood (Strip / Chinatown / Downtown / Off-Strip)
suggestions.detail: Easier to plan a day by area. Uses existing S1 area labels.

suggestions.title: Collect social links from official sites and platform search
suggestions.detail: Fill the Social column for all 24 restaurants and all activities, marking each link's source.

suggestions.title: Choose trip length before pricing
